title: Approved KB Snapshot
description: Schema for approved, versioned, and traceable classifier/intelligence knowledge base snapshots for downstream consumption.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this approved_kb_snapshot payload.

snapshot_id.description: Stable identifier for this approved KB snapshot.

snapshot_version.description: Semantic version for this approved KB snapshot.

snapshot_name.description: Human-readable name for this approved KB snapshot.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this approved KB snapshot was generated.

generated_by.description: Local producer or reviewed workflow identifier.

status.description: Review and lifecycle status for this approved KB snapshot.

country_scope.description: Country or regional codes explicitly covered by this snapshot.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Human-readable jurisdictions explicitly covered by this snapshot.

nomenclature_scope.description: Nomenclature or tariff schedule scope covered by this snapshot.

source_version_refs.description: Source version identifiers backing this approved KB snapshot.

approved_artifact_refs.description: Approved artifact identifiers included in this export-ready KB snapshot.

review_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the review_manifest approving this snapshot.

jurisdiction_pack_ref.description: Reference to the jurisdiction_pack that scopes this snapshot.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence artifact references supporting this snapshot. Raw evidence bodies are not embedded.

content_summary.description: Bounded human-readable summary of included approved KB content.

included_artifact_types.description: Artifact types included in this approved KB snapshot.

effective_from.description: Date when this approved KB snapshot becomes effective.

limitations.description: Known limitations for downstream consumption of this snapshot.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether downstream consumption is allowed under the current review state.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

valid_until.description: Optional UTC timestamp until this snapshot remains valid.

supersedes_snapshot_ref.description: Optional reference to a prior approved KB snapshot superseded by this one.

source_snapshot_refs.description: Optional source snapshot references included in this approved KB snapshot.

regulatory_delta_refs.description: Optional reviewed regulatory delta references included in this snapshot.

relevance_assessment_refs.description: Optional relevance assessment references included in this snapshot.

affected_codes.description: Optional nomenclature, tariff, or regulatory codes covered by this snapshot.

affected_topics.description: Optional regulatory or operational topics covered by this snapshot.

supported_country_packs.description: Optional jurisdiction_pack references supported by this snapshot.

language.description: Optional primary language tag for this snapshot.

checksum.description: Optional snapshot checksum in sha256 format with optional prefix.

export_format.description: Optional export format for this snapshot manifest.

reviewer_notes.description: Optional reviewer notes preserving audit context.

uncertainty_notes.description: Optional uncertainty notes for downstream interpretation.
